FCL · LCL

Ocean Freight

Container shipping between the world’s major ports — port to port, or door to door with pickup, clearance and delivery arranged for you.

Get a quote

What's included

  • Full container load (FCL)

    20ft, 40ft and 40ft high-cube containers reserved for your cargo alone.

  • Less than container load (LCL)

    Share container space and pay only for the volume you use when your cargo won’t fill a container.

  • Special equipment

    Refrigerated, open-top and flat-rack containers for temperature-controlled or oversized cargo.

  • Door to door

    Pickup at origin, export and import clearance, and final delivery in one booking.

How it works

  1. 01

    Share the details

    Goods, weight and volume, origin, destination, and your Incoterm.

  2. 02

    Quote and booking

    We recommend FCL or LCL, confirm the schedule and book space with the carrier.

  3. 03

    Loading and departure

    Pickup, export clearance and loading at the port of origin.

  4. 04

    Arrival and delivery

    Import clearance at destination and delivery to your door.

Documents you'll need

Exact requirements depend on the goods and the countries involved — we confirm the list with your quote.

  • Commercial invoice
  • Packing list
  • Bill of lading (issued by the carrier)
  • Certificate of origin
  • Permits or approvals for restricted goods

Questions

Should I ship FCL or LCL?

If your cargo fills most of a container, FCL is usually better value and faster. For smaller shipments, LCL lets you share space and pay for your volume only. We compare both with your quote.

What are demurrage and detention?

Carriers allow a number of free days. Demurrage is charged when a container stays in the port beyond them; detention when it is kept outside the port too long. Having documents ready before arrival is the best way to avoid both.

Which Incoterms do you work with?

Tell us the Incoterm on your purchase or sale — for example EXW, FOB or CIF — and we quote the parts of the journey you are responsible for.

أسئلة شائعة

هل أشحن بحاوية كاملة أم جزئية؟

إذا كانت بضاعتك تملأ معظم الحاوية، فالحاوية الكاملة غالباً أوفر وأسرع. وللشحنات الصغيرة يتيح الشحن الجزئي مشاركة المساحة والدفع مقابل حجمك فقط. نقارن الخيارين في عرض السعر.

ما هي رسوم الديمريج والاحتجاز؟

يمنح الناقلون عدداً من الأيام المجانية. الديمريج رسم يُفرض عند بقاء الحاوية في الميناء بعدها، والاحتجاز عند إبقائها خارج الميناء مدة أطول. تجهيز المستندات قبل الوصول هو أفضل طريقة لتجنبهما.

ما شروط التسليم (Incoterms) التي تعملون بها؟

أخبرنا بشرط التسليم في عقد الشراء أو البيع — مثل EXW أو FOB أو CIF — وسنسعّر أجزاء الرحلة التي تقع على مسؤوليتك.
